title: Record menu and Notes page
summary: Two clicks on the record button open a menu: Record audio, Record video, Notes. The Notes page lists the recordings and the notes that you write. Each note can be transcribed, sent to Claude in this session or in a new session, or deleted, and shows the state of its view. Settings has the transcription (Browser by default) and the task for new sessions.
actions: To use Send now new session, make a scheduled task that starts a new session at each run, and put its id into Settings, New session task.
Recording and transcription work only when you open the page from the repo on your computer: claude.ai blocks the microphone.

session.words: Reading of the ask: (1) set up a workspace with a git repo for this project's work. No repos are attached yet; check list_repos for a suitable one (e.g. agent_os/agents_os). If none exists, init a local git repo in the workspace and ask Andrei to create a GitHub repo so you can attach and push. (2) Publish an HTML artifact that's otherwise empty and holds the user's JSON, exactly as given in the m
